title: The Planet with a Long Day

beats.narration: On one planet, a single day is actually longer than its entire year.

beats.narration: It is Venus. It takes 243 Earth days to spin once on its axis.

beats.heading: Venus

beats.narration: Venus takes 243 days to rotate, but only 225 days to orbit the Sun.

beats.heading: Day vs Year

beats.narration: Venus also spins backwards. This means the Sun rises in the west.
